say:1:1841115001:1.text: Don't look at me like that. I had nothing to do with the candle blossom.
say:1:1841115001:1.source_cn: 别用那种奇怪的眼神盯着余。赤烛蕊的出现，可不是余的手笔。
say:1:1841115001:1.male: Don't look at me like that. I had nothing to do with the candle blossom.
say:1:1841115001:1.female: Don't look at me like that. I had nothing to do with the candle blossom.

say:2:1841115002:1.text: It was the work of my predecessor—my sister in name only.
say:2:1841115002:1.source_cn: 它是前任领主——余名义上的姐妹——捏造出来的植物。
say:2:1841115002:1.male: It was the work of my predecessor—my sister in name only.
say:2:1841115002:1.female: It was the work of my predecessor—my sister in name only.

say:3:1841115003:1.text: She loved two things: gardening and falling in love. At the time, the Lightbearer Empire had a celebrated beauty. My sister took one look at her and declared it love at first sight. Her words, of course.
say:3:1841115003:1.source_cn: 她素来喜爱莳花弄草，又一向风流。彼时的耀光有一位极为出...
say:3:1841115003:1.male: She loved two things: gardening and falling in love. At the time, the Lightbearer Empire had a celebrated beauty. My sister took one look at her and declared it love at first sight. Her words, of course.
say:3:1841115003:1.female: She loved two things: gardening and falling in love. At the time, the Lightbearer Empire had a celebrated beauty. My sister took one look at her and declared it love at first sight. Her words, of course.

say:4:1841115004:1.text: When she heard the woman loved red flowers, she shut herself in the greenhouse and set out to create the most dazzling red flower in the world.
say:4:1841115004:1.source_cn: 听说对方最爱红色的花，她就把自己关在温室里，决心要造出...
say:4:1841115004:1.male: When she heard the woman loved red flowers, she shut herself in the greenhouse and set out to create the most dazzling red flower in the world.
say:4:1841115004:1.female: When she heard the woman loved red flowers, she shut herself in the greenhouse and set out to create the most dazzling red flower in the world.

say:5:1841115005:1.text: The result was the candle blossom.
say:5:1841115005:1.male: The result was the candle blossom.
say:5:1841115005:1.female: The result was the candle blossom.

choice_prompt:6:1841115005.text: The result was the candle blossom.
choice_prompt:6:1841115005.male: The result was the candle blossom.
choice_prompt:6:1841115005.female: The result was the candle blossom.

say:7:1841115006:1.text: She never got the chance. If she had, the whole Lightbearer Empire might be buried under candle blossoms by now.
say:7:1841115006:1.source_cn: 她没有那种机会，否则耀光早已被她送出的赤烛蕊吞没。
say:7:1841115006:1.male: She never got the chance. If she had, the whole Lightbearer Empire might be buried under candle blossoms by now.
say:7:1841115006:1.female: She never got the chance. If she had, the whole Lightbearer Empire might be buried under candle blossoms by now.

say:8:1841115007:1.text: Luckily, they only overran the castle and the manor, took root in more than a dozen blood thralls, and made Father so furious that he moved the entire manor into this magic realm.
say:8:1841115007:1.source_cn: 赤烛蕊不过是淹没了城堡和庄园，害得十几位血仆没能逃脱它...
say:8:1841115007:1.male: Luckily, they only overran the castle and the manor, took root in more than a dozen blood thralls, and made Father so furious that he moved the entire manor into this magic realm.
say:8:1841115007:1.female: Luckily, they only overran the castle and the manor, took root in more than a dozen blood thralls, and made Father so furious that he moved the entire manor into this magic realm.

say:9:1841115008:1.text: The old site of Mortimer Manor became what you now know as the Gravebloom Fields.
say:9:1841115008:1.source_cn: 莫蒂默庄园的旧址，就变成了如今的苍骸花海。

say:11:1841115009:1.text: The woman was terrified. Apparently, she moved to the one city in the Lightbearer Empire that was farthest from Novaris.
say:11:1841115009:1.source_cn: 那位美人可吓坏了，听说直接搬到了耀光帝国境内距离诺珐斯...

say:14:1841115012:1.text: My sister made the illusion in that woman's image.

say:15:1841115013:1.text: I never saw the woman herself. But judging by the illusion, she still had nothing on Senea when she's on stage. Wouldn't you agree?
say:15:1841115013:1.source_cn: 余没有见过那位美人。但以余之见，这造影不如舞台上的塞涅...
